welcome.title: A little sunshine for you
welcome.label: A WATERCOLOR WELCOME FROM AMY
welcome.description: Your first little surprise. Open it slowly. Stay as long as you like.
welcome.alt: A magenta, teal, cobalt and emerald watercolor welcome letter, with Amy, a playful doodle and the shoreline. A complete clear-text version is available below.

blocks.text: I’m so excited you’re here! There’s room for your real life, your honest questions, and a little creative joy.

Get ready for a mix of encouraging notes, creative sparks, faith-filled reminders, fun ideas, and a whole lot of real-life, Jesus-loving, messy-beautiful inspiration—all sent with love from Chaotic Sunshine.
Make something. Try something. Share a little joy with a friend as we discover more about God, life, and love together.
Our hope? To bring a little more joy, hope, creativity, and sunshine to your mailbox in the days ahead!
This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
